# KCC20 Wallet SDK (SCORPION)

> Plug-and-play Kaspa KCC20 dApp SDK. Not a Chrome extension. Keys never leave the hosted PWA. Any vibe-coding platform (Replit, Base44, Cursor, v0, Claude, Grok, Copilot) can load one script and let a user buy every KCC20 token launched on kron.technology.

Website: https://kcc20-sdk.vercel.app
Wallet (keys live here): https://kcc-20-wallet.vercel.app
SDK script: https://kcc-20-wallet.vercel.app/sdk.js?v=168
Argent compiler: https://kcc20-sdk.vercel.app/argent.js
GitHub: https://github.com/mrzeku2000XTTT/kcc20-sdk
Wallet app: https://github.com/mrzeku2000XTTT/KCC20-wallet

Require `window.kcc20.sdkVersion >= "168"` (`buyKron` + `compileVault` + `sendKas`). Only call Connect from a **user click**. After Approve the popup **closes on purpose**. Then silent reads work.

## Canonical KRON sources (do not invent ticks)

- Tokenlist: https://api.kron.technology/api/registry/tokenlist
- Tokenlist all: https://api.kron.technology/api/registry/tokenlist?all=1
- Indexer: https://idx.kron.technology/v1/kcc20
- Launch site: https://kron.technology

Skip tickers that are empty or contain `?`. Use `symbol` as `tick`. `buyKron({ tick, amount })` amount is **KAS to spend**, not tokens.

## Smallest shop (copy this)

```html
<script src="https://kcc-20-wallet.vercel.app/sdk.js?v=167"></script>
```

```js
const kcc = window.kcc20;
const accounts = await kcc.connect();            // click only
const bag = await kcc.getTokenBalance('KKDAG');  // silent
const bought = await kcc.buyKron({ tick: 'KKDAG', amount: '10' });
// bought.txId   bought.quote   bought.explorer
```

`sendToken({ tick, amount, dest })` transfers a bag they **already hold**. Do **not** use it to buy. Do **not** build KRON curve/pool PSKTs for a shop — the wallet does that in `buyKron`.

## Other methods

| Call | When |
|---|---|
| `connect()` | Popup. Once per session. |
| `getAccounts` / `getNetwork` / `getPublicKey` / `getUtxoEntries` / `getBalance` / `getHoldings` / `getTokenBalance` | Silent after Connect |
| `buyKron({ tick, amount })` | Buy KCC20 with KAS. amount = KAS |
| `sellKron({ tick, amount })` | Sell. amount = tokens |
| `quoteKron({ tick, side, amount })` | Optional preview |
| `sendToken({ tick, amount, dest })` | Send held bag to `kaspa:q…` |
| `signPskt({ txJsonString, options })` | You built the tx. P2PK only. `signInputs.index` is **global** `tx.inputs[]` |
| `pushTx(signed)` | Returns `{ txId, node }` — read `.txId` |
| `compileVault({ type, params })` | Argent compiles a P2SH `kaspa:p`. User PIN-funds. Not a send. |
| `sendKas({ dest, amount })` | Plain KAS to `kaspa:q`. “Send to grandson” is this, not a vault. |
| `disconnect()` | Stay on the dApp tab |

Never ask for seed, PIN, or 64-hex. Never overwrite a real `window.kasware`. KIP-12: `kaspa:provider` `rdns: app.kcc20.wallet`.

## Wallets

This SDK helps **any** dApp wallet picker and any Kaspa wallet:

1. dApps load `sdk.js` → users sign in KCC20 (SCORPION).
2. Wallet-agnostic apps listen for `kaspa:provider` and list SCORPION next to KasWare.
3. Other wallets can copy the same surface: Connect on click, silent reads after close, wallet-built `buyKron`, `signPskt` P2PK-only global indexes, `pushTx` → `{ txId, node }`.
